defect: Two clocks are defined on the same mux output pin without -add, so the second definition replaces the first.
rationale: The selected domain is driven by either clk_a_i or clk_b_i. Both possible propagated clocks must coexist on the mux output pin; the second create_clock lacks -add and leaves only one scenario represented.

mutation.description: Declared the second clock on a mux output pin without -add, replacing the first clock definition.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.note: Creating selected_b on the same target without -add replaces selected_a, losing one mux input clock. The data delays still reference the replaced selected_a; selected_b also has no data interface delays.
